reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept MOVE {identifier-1 | literal-1} TO {identifier-2} ... (Format 1) and MOVE {CORRESPONDING | CORR} identifier-1 TO identifier-2 (Format 2, a level-2 Nucleus element that a full-level implementation provides) and refuse every shape neither format prints; the witness covers the accepted shapes only.

edition-consulted.switches: only the citation text of the COBOL2173 hint (EditionOf(recognizer).Cite: §1985:VI.6.19.2 vs ISO §2023:14.9.25.2)
refuses the inlineMethodInvocation alternative of sendingOperand before 2002 (COBOL0900)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|ConstructRegistry in MoveBinder.cs (only ctx.Edition diagnostic sinks and the FROM/INTO phrase arms, not the MOVE format path); the grammar rules carry no edition predicate; no subset-level (Nucleus level 1/2) switch exists anywhere in src (grep 'subset level|SubsetLevel|NucleusLevel').
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: both formats are the same at 1985 and 2023; only the inline-method-invocation sending operand (2002+) is gated off at 85.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb421 exercises the accepted spellings; the refusal half (CORRESPONDING after a sending operand, a second Format-2 receiver, missing TO, missing sending operand) and the 2002 inline-invocation operand are not exercised.

probes.printed: B=ABAB C=ABAB / N=+000.0 / NE=- 12.5 / B=BCDB / V=QRS / G2=123XYZ / G2=123XYZ (ALL literal to two receivers, figurative ZERO, signed and edited, refmod both sides, ODO group receiver, MOVE CORRESPONDING and CORR); the two lines that differed from my expected file were slips in that file (DISPLAY of a signed V9 item, fixed-insertion minus), the printed values are the rule's result

reader.notes: The grammar spells exactly the two printed formats (one alternative each) and the error strategy names the one tempting non-format shape. The level-2 box on Format 2 marks a Nucleus level-2 element, not an edition difference; the compiler implements the full level and has no subset mode, so acceptance at 85 is right. The second-receiver refusal (c08m3) carries a generic missing-period message, a weak diagnosis but still a compile-time refusal.
